icecore.map.title: Island map
icecore.map.save_before_bind: Save the draft before binding a source
icecore.map.help.select: Search existing regions. Requires a region and no active outline or export.
icecore.map.help.new: Enter a unique ID, create a region, then left-click map points. Use lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens.
icecore.map.help.bounds_apply: Apply current bounds, expansion and feather to the local draft, then Save regions to persist them. Bounds: minX,minZ,maxX,maxZ; maximum 16384 blocks per axis.
icecore.map.help.save: Save the current bounds, expansion, feather and all region drafts to the server. Applying bounds first is optional. Finish or cancel drawing first. Temporarily disabled while awaiting confirmation.
icecore.map.help.draw: Start drawing vertices. Switch to selecting shared edges in region tools. Finish or cancel the current contour first.
icecore.map.help.finish: Close and apply at least three valid vertices. Export bounds expand to include the outline and feather. Save afterwards.
icecore.map.help.undo: Undo the latest action: edge mode clears the end or start first, then rolls back the most recently accepted path and source insertions. Drawing mode removes the last vertex.
icecore.map.help.remove_contour: Remove the last drawn outline, or clear the bound footprint if none remain. Save afterwards.
icecore.map.help.source: Search registered islands or building regions for a binding source. Requires an available source.
icecore.map.help.bind: Resample the selected source and save its footprint. Save all draft edits first. Requires a saved region and a source.
icecore.map.help.cancel_draw: Discard this outline edit and retain the original. A newly created region remains in the draft.
icecore.map.help.delete: Delete the current region and its outlines from the draft. Save to apply. Unavailable while drawing or exporting.
icecore.map.help.snapshot: Export recorded Xaero surface terrain into a tile resource pack. Missing recordings preserve the previous atlas. Finish drawing first.
icecore.map.help.cancel_snapshot: Cancel the active export and preserve the previous atlas. Available only during export.
icecore.map.help.edit_contour: Select an outline. Drag yellow vertices or left-click to append. Use arrow keys to pan. Finish replaces the original; cancel preserves it.
icecore.map.help.close: Close the map. Unsaved edits are discarded. Use Cancel snapshot to stop a running export.
icecore.map.help.region_id: Unique ID for a new region. Editing this field does not rename existing regions. Enter a new ID and choose Create.
icecore.map.help.expansion: Projection padding, 0–512 blocks; applies to bound footprints only. Hand drawn contours are the outer fog boundary and never expand.
icecore.map.help.feather: Inward fog fade width, 1–512 blocks. Outside is fully gray. Shared seams disappear when both regions unlock.
icecore.map.help.bounds: Atlas bounds: minX,minZ,maxX,maxZ; maximum is exclusive. Drawn contours are the outer fog boundary. Bounds do not unlock terrain.
icecore.map.help.search: Type to filter entries. Scroll to page through results.
icecore.map.help.choice: Select %s and return to the map editor.
icecore.map.help.back: Cancel this selection and return, retaining the draft.
icecore.map.xaero_not_ready: Xaero is not ready yet. Reopen the editor shortly.
icecore.map.not_published: No map snapshot has been published. Ask an operator to record and export the map.
icecore.map.capture_missing: Chunk %s, %s is needed by a region or its feather. Record it in Xaero, then export again.
icecore.map.pack_failed: The map resource pack could not be loaded. The previous map is preserved. Check the client log.
icecore.map.trace_start: Choose a start point on a neighboring outline
icecore.map.trace_end: Choose an end point on the same outline
icecore.map.trace_confirm: Cyan shows the proposed path. Reverse it if needed, then use the boundary path.
icecore.map.help.tools: Open partition tools: snapping, shared vertices, boundary tracing, outline editing and local unlock preview.
icecore.map.help.snap: Snap to nearby vertices or edges within 6 GUI pixels. Hold Alt to bypass. Edge points are inserted in the neighboring outline when the edit is committed.
icecore.map.help.link: Enabled by default. Move matching shared vertices in other drawn outlines together. Finish validates all edits; cancel retains every original outline.
icecore.map.help.trace: Switch to shared edge selection. Clicks only pick boundaries, never yellow vertices. Cyan is hovered, white is start, orange is the proposed path. Stays in edge mode after accepting.
icecore.map.help.reverse: Reverse the proposed route between two distinct points on the same outline. Cyan preview does not commit changes.
icecore.map.help.accept_edge: Accept the orange path and insert matching endpoints into the source contour. Remains in edge selection without yellow vertices. Switch back to drawing explicitly. Finish commits; cancel rolls back.
icecore.map.help.preview: Preview local unlock combinations over recorded Xaero terrain using the draft. Never writes server unlocks. Finish or cancel drawing first.
icecore.map.help.back_tools: Return to editing, retaining the camera, selection and unsaved draft.
icecore.map.help.preview_all: Preview every region unlocked locally. Shared server unlocks are unchanged.
icecore.map.help.preview_none: Preview every region locked locally. Select a region to toggle its preview state.
icecore.map.help.preview_toggle: Choose a region to toggle its local preview only. Server unlocks remain unchanged.
icecore.map.point_status: Draw vertices: click to add or drag a vertex; switch to shared edge selection in tools
icecore.map.help.point_mode: Switch to drawing vertices. Only this mode shows yellow vertices and the rubber band. Left click adds or drags vertices.
